description: §42.4: `if=@o.v` (`""`) and `else-if=@o.n` (`0`) are presence tests over defined values — both elements render; `if=@flag` (`false`) is a boolean test and does not.
rationale: §42.4 statement 2: the presence test "is true when the value is not `not`"; "The defined values `""`, `0`, `false`, `[]` and `{}` are PRESENT (§42.1.1)"; "The test SHALL lower to an absence check (§42.5), never to the host language's truthiness." Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S460 "a′, go" (supersedes S440 Truthiness Q2 for conditions; keeps S440 #4 = (c), Q1, Gotcha Q2, S442).
